faqs.q: How much does a website cost in Raigad district?
a: A brochure site costs ₹15,000 to ₹40,000. A business site costs ₹30,000 to ₹60,000. A homestay site with a booking form costs ₹40,000 to ₹80,000. A guesthouse with a booking engine costs ₹80,000 to ₹1,20,000. A resort with OTA integration costs ₹1,20,000 to ₹2,00,000. See the

faqs.q: Is a local Raigad developer cheaper than a Mumbai developer?
a: Usually 15–30% cheaper for the same scope. But the talent pool is smaller in Raigad, so for complex projects the wider Mumbai or Pune pool may be worth the cost premium. See the

faqs.q: What is the cheapest way to get a website in Raigad?
a: A template-based brochure site with content you provide yourself, from a solo freelancer. This typically costs ₹15,000 to ₹40,000. Avoiding custom design, professional photography, and booking engines keeps the cost down.

faqs.q: What is the biggest cost driver for a Raigad website?
a: The booking engine, for tourism sites. For non-tourism sites, custom design is the biggest driver. Both are worth it only in specific situations — most Raigad businesses do not need either.

faqs.q: Do I need to pay for professional photography?
a: For a tourism business (homestay, resort, restaurant), yes — good photos are often the difference between a booking and no booking. For a local shop or service business, your own photos are usually sufficient. Photography costs ₹15,000 to ₹50,000 for a property shoot.

faqs.q: What is a fair price for website maintenance in Raigad?
a: ₹1,000 to ₹6,000 per month depending on the site's complexity. For a brochure site, ₹1,000 to ₹2,500 per month is typical. For a tourism site with a booking engine, ₹3,000 to ₹6,000 per month is typical. If the developer does not offer maintenance at all, that is a red flag.

faqs.q: How does the cost compare to Mumbai or Pune?
a: Raigad is 15–30% cheaper than Mumbai and 10–20% cheaper than Pune for the same scope. See the

faqs.q: Can I get a website for under ₹20,000 in Raigad?
a: Yes, for a very simple brochure site (3 pages, template-based, content provided by you). Below ₹15,000 is usually a sign of a template installer rather than a developer, and quality may be limited. Above ₹40,000 for the same scope is usually a sign of overcharging.

faqs.q: What if the quote I got is much higher than these ranges?
a: It could mean (1) the scope is larger than a standard project, (2) the developer is quoting an agency rate, or (3) the developer is overcharging. Get a second quote against the same scope, and compare the scopes — not just the prices. See the
